type_definitions.name: SympyConsistencyReport

workflows.description: executable symbolic algebra autoformalization over SymPy using source parsing, assumption modeling, local API grounding, symbolic validation, bounded counterexample search, trace verification, and reference-free consistency metrics.

epistemic_contract.assurance_justification: Each occurrence preserves its own generated or computed provenance; the final wrapper follows the final occurrence.
epistemic_contract.defeater_rationale: Evidence labels remain capped until native adapters and independent behavioral oracles execute.
defeaters: A structural or fake-handler run does not establish native execution, mathematical correctness, or semantic equivalence.
observations: The canonical hook registry fixes hook order, owner skills, declared outputs, and gate text.
epistemic_contract.output_meaning: The final domain-specific artifact produced by the layered sympy_equational_trace_loop shell.
epistemic_contract.question: What typed artifacts and dispositions result from the declared sympy_equational_trace_loop contract?
epistemic_contract.subject: The exact source artifacts and gates traversed by sympy_equational_trace_loop.

reasoning_projection.description: Parse source equations, ground their assumptions and SymPy APIs, draft and execute an artifact, validate its identity and trace, and report consistency.
reasoning_projection.name: TraceSympyEquations

occurrences.rationale: Expose equations, symbols, and the exact identity under investigation.
Model assumptions and establish scope-bound API applicability.
Construct an executable candidate while retaining validation obligations.
Execute the artifact and retain symbolic, numeric, and transformation-trace outputs.
Validate the identity, search bounded counterexamples, and verify every cited transformation.
Merge parsing, grounding, execution, identity, counterexample, and trace findings into a consistency report.

reasoning_projection.projection_scope: one source-to-execution SymPy derivation with bounded validation and a consistency report
